run.title: Quadratic function approximation with a tuned constant learning rate
run.what_changed: Post-hoc function-approximation run (EXPERIMENTS.md §8.4), registered 2026-11-05 before running. The tabular Q-table is replaced by a linear Q-function on 45 quadratic features of the weights, the correctly specified reference model and never the discovery result. Constant α = 3.2e-4 and l2 = 0, tuned on separate seeds (master seed 20261103, results/tuning/fa_tuning.json); greedy portfolio refreshed every 100 updates. Everything else as tabular-const: B = 20, 13M episodes, ε 1% at halfway, 20% grid, γ = 3, 5, 8, 10 seeds, master seed 20261016. Trained at commit bc311a3 (tag fa-quadratic).
